items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson not spotted at Friday practice (third straight DNP this week) after left ankle sprain; Tyler Huntley likely starts again vs Browns. Hasn't played since Week 4.
items.why: Missed all practices; ankle recovery incomplete.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens still scoring well historically with him (33+ PPG in recent fills).
items.opportunity: Huntley QB stream; Flowers/Andrews retain value but ceiling lower without Lamar dual-threat.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) officially ruled out again for Sunday vs Patriots; third straight miss. Adonai Mitchell also OUT.
items.implication: Full backfield load to Braelon Allen again.
items.opportunity: Allen 90 snaps in prior full games without Hall per Levitan; start Allen confidently.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee), S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not travel to London and ruled OUT vs Jaguars.
items.why: Injuries prevent travel for London game.
items.implication: Woody Marks full snaps/touches as in prior absence (98% snaps, all RB touches).
items.opportunity: Marks RB2 upside despite matchup; Dell absence boosts other HOU WRs/TE.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled out for Week 6 vs Panthers due to superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; indefinite absence as treatment determined. Tanner McKee to start; Eagles added Joe Milton from Cowboys PS for depth.
items.why: Ultrasound revealed movement in small superficial blood clot after initial clearance; health priority.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles offense/implied total tanks; boost to pass-catchers if volume holds, handcuff QBs.
items.opportunity: Increased targets possible for Goedert/Wicks/Smith if healthy; McKee streaming upside limited.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley no practice again Thursday (hamstring); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited. Barkley status uncertain for Sunday vs Panthers amid Hurts OUT.
items.implication: If OUT, Dameon Pierce lead; McKee/Smith/Wicks volume shifts. Monitor Friday report.
items.opportunity: Pierce handcuff elevate; Goedert already leading targets.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice did not practice again (hamstring); status for Week 6 uncertain.
items.implication: If out, Worthy/others elevated; monitor for ACTIVE.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day (hamstring); on track to start vs Falcons.
items.implication: Return upgrades Bears pass catchers (Odunze/Burden/Moore?); QB stream/start viable.
items.opportunity: Rome Odunze, Luther Burden routes/targets with starting QB.

items.text: Loves Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI elite usage), Javonte Williams (RB8 goal-line @GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ). Henderson multi-week high-ankle out; Stevenson 85% snaps/23 touches prior, 16.3 PPG on 15+ touches.
items.why: Volume + soft run Ds for RBs; London usage bankable; Henderson out multi-week elevates Stevenson fully.
items.implication: Start all confidently; Stevenson borderline RB1 while Henderson sidelined.
items.opportunity: Stevenson high snap/touch share; Kyren elite recent usage; Javonte RZ.

items.text: LOVE love love Mike Evans vs Commanders secondary; Evans is my WR4 for Week 6. High target share (36% recently), Deebo out multi-week boosts him further.
items.why: Commanders soft vs WR; season-high targets; Deebo multi-week out leaves thin depth behind.
items.opportunity: 45%+ target rate when Deebo off; elite volume.

items.text: Cardinals trade Marvin Harrison Jr. to HOU. Adam Levitan/Evan Silva: Kendrick Bourne will get open more and earn more targets than MHJ did. Jaylen Warren monster day as Rico Dowdle return looms; Jayden Daniels excellent return.
items.why: MHJ traded; Bourne projected higher target earning/openness in ARI offense.
items.implication: Bourne waiver/priority add WR3/flex; MHJ to HOU changes roles (Nico etc.). Warren hold vs Dowdle.
items.opportunity: Bourne routes/targets surge; Warren lead if Dowdle limited.

items.text: RB snaps in two full games since Breece Hall injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0. Allen fully absorbing workload.
items.why: Snap counts post-Hall injury confirm Allen as clear lead.
items.implication: Allen must-start RB2/flex while Hall out; no committee.
items.opportunity: 90%+ snaps, primary carries/routes for Jets RBs.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA; 67% yards in one game, else 16.5 ypg), Emeka Egbuka (WR34 vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (TE18), Bo Nix (QB23 vs SEA elite pass D), Justin Herbert (QB25 low total @KC). Also fades Woody Marks/JK Dobbins tough run Ds.
items.why: Ugly matchups (SEA pass D), shaky QB/volume for WRs/TEs, low team totals/scoring ruts.
items.implication: Sit/fade these; pivot to better spots.
items.opportunity: Waddle low consistent targets/yards; others suppressed roles/matchups.

items.text: Loves Brock Purdy (QB2 vs WSH), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH), Matthew Stafford/Jordan Love in shootouts. WSH defense buffet for pass catchers. Likes Tanner McKee somewhat post-Hurts OUT.
items.why: Commanders soft vs pass; high-scoring environments.
items.implication: Purdy top QB play; Kittle TE1 weekly.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins/McNabb/McCoy/Ertz). Saquon turns 30 in Feb; if Super Bowl contender with RB need, at least call. Worth risk moving year early vs late.
items.why: Age 30 + Eagles precedent of early exits from stars; contending teams should inquire.
items.implication: Long-term trade value/ROS risk elevated if contenders call; short-term if healthy still elite.
